issue.title: [devin-remediate] getOwnerName renders undefined for partial owner records
issue.body:
## Problem
`Owner.first_name`, `last_name`, and `full_name` are optional, but `getOwnerName` can produce strings like `Ada undefined` or `undefined Lovelace` for partial owner records.

## Target
`superset-frontend/src/utils/getOwnerName.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Prefer `full_name` when present.
- Otherwise join the available first and last name parts without rendering `undefined`.
- Return `email` when no name fields are present.
- Return an empty string when no displayable owner field exists.

## Suggested test command
`cd superset-frontend && yarn test src/utils/getOwnerName.test.ts`

Please open a PR against this fork.
